cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
前 12 天每天 1–4 颗星
昨天一口气涨了 2,270
cover.dek: vercel-labs/agent-desktop 读系统无障碍树来做桌面 computer use，不靠截图猜像素。项目前 12 天几乎没人理，这两天突然起飞，值得去看看它凭什么。
cover.title_en:
Four stars a day at most for 12 days,
then 2,270 in a single day
cover.dek_en: vercel-labs/agent-desktop does desktop computer use by reading the OS accessibility tree instead of guessing at pixels from screenshots. It sat nearly unnoticed for 12 days, then took off, and it's worth a look at why.

stickers.title: 记忆层回暖
stickers.text: claude-mem 日增从每天 170–340 跳到 +1,523，最近三天连续走高。
stickers.text_en: claude-mem went from 170–340 stars a day to +1,523, rising three days in a row.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: 2610.34577 比较了 17 种验证设计，独立 critic 复审性价比最高。
stickers.text_en: 2610.34577 compares 17 verification designs and finds an independent critic review gives the best value.

stickers.title: 省 token
stickers.text: 微软的 TokenEconomizer 10 月 13 日创建，已有 3,643 星，连续 4 天高增长。
stickers.text_en: Microsoft's TokenEconomizer, created Oct 13, has 3,643 stars and four straight days of strong growth.
